extracted.name: Striker's Potatoes O'Brien
extracted.description: Keep this Striker's potatoes O'Brien recipe, which is a tasty mix of potatoes, onions, and bell peppers, in the freezer for a quick and easy breakfast.
ingredient_lines: 1 large green bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch dice
1 large red bell pepper, cut into 1/2-inch dice
instruction_lines: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer 10 minutes. Drain. Cool, then cut into a 1/2-inch dice.
Combine potatoes, onion, and bell peppers in a bowl; drizzle in vegetable oil and gently stir until evenly coated. Transfer mixture to resealable plastic freezer bags; store in the freezer.
To prepare, cook frozen potato mixture in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until crispy and golden brown, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes.
